subject: Wire transfer confirmation — invoice #94821 ($24,300)
body:
Hello,

Please confirm the wire transfer for invoice #94821 totaling $24,300 is being processed this week. Updated routing info is below — note we recently moved banks:

Bank: Pacific Trust
Routing: 555012345
Account: 678901234

Reply with confirmation of the new banking details on file and expected ACH date.

Best regards,
Melissa Tran
AP Manager, NorthGrip Supply Co.

expected_outcome.notes: External vendor ACH/wire/bank-change request reaching a leadership inbox. The deterministic finance-safety guard (bin/triage-chain.py, runs before scope_gate) detects money-movement content to a finance/leadership/owner inbox regardless of sender and forces Finance / ACH / Owner Approval -> escalate to Owner, draft=null, in scope. Closes the BEC / vendor-payment-change hole the original strict scope_gate left open (an external sender used to fall through to out_of_scope).
